record.what_it_does: Google's AI research notebook; Enterprise edition exposes a preview notebooks API.
record.auth_notes: Docs authenticate with a Google user access token (`gcloud auth print-access-token`, Bearer header). The RPC reference lists these OAuth scopes: cloud-platform, discoveryengine.readwrite and discoveryengine.serving.readwrite, plus discoveryengine.assist.readwrite for BatchCreateSources. Adding Drive sources needs user credentials with Drive access. The caller must be a user with a Gemini Notebook for business/Enterprise license and the roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser role. The docs don't mention service accounts, and the per-user license requirement makes service-account use unlikely. This is unconfirmed.
record.access_notes: API calls need a user with an active Gemini Notebook license. Licenses are bought as subscriptions from the Gemini Enterprise page of the Cloud console and billed monthly or yearly to the project's Cloud Billing account. A self-serve free trial gives a "full-featured, 14-day trial subscription of 5000 licenses". After that, a paid subscription is required. The licensing page lists no price. Gemini Enterprise seats reportedly start around $21–30 per user per month, from a non-English page snapshot that I didn't verify. The API is Pre-GA (v1alpha). Consumer NotebookLM has no public API.
record.api_breadth_notes:
About 11 operations on discoveryengine.googleapis.com v1alpha (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha):
- Notebooks: create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete, share.
- Sources: batchCreate, uploadFile, get, batchDelete. Supported sources are Drive Docs/Slides, raw text, web URLs, YouTube, and uploaded PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/TXT/MD, audio and image files.
- Audio overviews: create, delete.
The reference also lists DiscoverSourcesService and LabelService, but neither has published RPC methods. There is no list-notebooks-by-query endpoint and no chat/query endpoint.
record.mcp_notes: NotebookLM is not on Google's managed MCP "Supported products" page (docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products). The page lists an Agent Search MCP at discoveryengine.googleapis.com/mcp, which is a different product. Only community servers exist, e.g. pleaseprompto/notebooklm-mcp, PyPI notebooklm-mcp-server, mcp-notebooklm and moodrobotics/notebooklm-mcp-server. They are unofficial and mostly automate the consumer web app using cookies or browser sessions.
record.blocker_notes: End users need a paid Gemini Notebook/Gemini Enterprise license on a Google Cloud project; a developer can build and test on the 14-day trial. The API is v1alpha/Pre-GA. The surface covers notebook, source and audio-overview management, with no chat/query. Auth is user OAuth with cloud-platform scope, so a public OAuth app would likely face Google sensitive-scope verification. Consumer NotebookLM has no API.
